title.narrative: Meydan: Reclaiming Freedom of Assembly and Public Space

description.narrative:
The overall objective of the proposed project is to strengthen participatory democracy by monitoring challenges and opportunities for democratic and civic space.

The specific objectives are to empower civil society organizations and initiatives to reclaim public spaces for public demonstrations and assemblies; develop innovative ways of defending freedom of peaceful assembly and demonstration; and carry out high-impact advocacy for policies that promote participation and freedom of assembly.
